title: WINDSHIELD GARNISH MOLDINGS
summary: Interior windshield garnish moldings (windshield trim/reveal moldings inside the car): the upper molding across the windshield header and the side moldings down each windshield pillar (hinge pillar / A-pillar trim). The upper molding is screwed up into the windshield frame upper; each side molding is screwed at its top and snaps onto two fastener pads riveted to the hinge pillar (View B). Part numbers for the moldings come from charts (by color).

parts.name: CHART SIDE-GARNISH MOLDING
parts.name_expanded: Chart – side windshield garnish molding (windshield pillar trim)

parts.name: FASTENER
parts.name_expanded: Fastener – pad on hinge pillar that the side molding presses onto

fastening.note: Screws [2] go up from below through the upper molding [1] into the windshield frame header (main view).
View A: screw [6] goes through the end of upper molding [1] into the windshield frame-upper, at each corner.
View A: screw [2] goes up through the top end of side molding [3] into the windshield frame-upper. Holes .128/.131 dia., 6 places.
Screw [7] with lock washer [8] goes into a bracket at the top of the hinge pillar, at the upper end of side molding [3].
View B: each fastener pad [4] is riveted [5] to the hinge pillar through holes at its ends.
View B: side molding [3] presses onto the fastener pads [4] on the hinge pillar.
